body:
Approved implementation plan (auto-approved gate, epic #99 autonomous run)

Design: full lockstep rename of the per-agent tier — table agent_site_overrides → agent_site_rules (migration 003, copy-and-drop so DDL matches schema.sql; redundant index dropped), verdict/event source 'agent_override' → 'agent_rule' (site_policy_events rebuilt with new CHECK), functions setAgentRule/removeAgentRule, routes /api/ui/agents/:agentId/site-rules[/:domain], sites_changed reasons agent_rule_upsert|delete, api.js wrappers getAgentSiteRules/setAgentSiteRule/deleteAgentSiteRule. MCP-visible policySource value changes (CHANGELOG). Sites page: two-column grid (.wp-sites-cols, collapses <1100px): left "Enable Global Block List" card (subtitle "Applies to all agents regardless of their custom rules.", toggle, View / manage list → global list modal grouped user allows → user blocks → signed, search, 25/page, in-place delete confirm, add form rejecting *); right "Per-agent rules" (agent picker, * pinned as "All sites", add form accepting *). Below: "Site access log" table (agent + decision filters, load more, source/matched/hits detail) with "Revoke for this agent" / "Allow for this agent"; Allow uses a new TypedConfirmModal requiring "i understand" (Enter does nothing until it matches); Revoke uses ConfirmModal with agent-only wording. ConfirmModal's window Enter-to-confirm listener removed (design rule). ws.js emits 'reconnected' → page refetches. Copy fixes for the toggle tooltip and two server error messages.

Sub-tasks:
- [sub-task 1] Backend rename + migration 003 + all server tests + copy fixes (complex)
- [sub-task 2] api.js wrapper rename + ws.js reconnected + minimal page identifier rename (light)
- [sub-task 3] TypedConfirmModal + story; ConfirmModal Enter fix (standard)
- [sub-task 4] Sites page rewrite: page.js + GlobalListModal/AgentRulesPanel/SiteEventLog + CSS (complex) — after 2, 3
- [sub-task 5] CHANGELOG (light)
- [sub-task 6] Verification: server tests, web build, grep, migrated-DB smoke, UI check (standard) — last

Deferred: popup pill keys (#105); docs rewrite (#106) — DOCS phase here covers SCHEMA_MIGRATIONS.md, MCP_SERVER.md routes/table, DESIGN_AND_UX.md Sites description.
